description: The verify MCP server (servers/verify-mcp), werkrbee's stand-in for a product's tools until one accepts Barry's Entra token: one gated tool that records a note in memory, used to check after each deploy that a gated call pauses for a person and runs once approved. Its card URL is the server's in werkrbee's Container Apps environment, and its token scope is its API app's, from entra.sh --agent verify.

mcp.name: verify
mcp.description: One gated tool that records a note in memory, for checking hosted Barry.
